record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.original_question: Consider the nonlocal conflict-zone model in which the cognitive map evolves by ∂_t k_i = u_i g,R Σ_j=1^n ρ_ij u_j − (μ + βu_i)k_i, so that conflicts can be perceived at a distance before being remembered. Under periodic boundary conditions in a bounded domain with a top-hat detection function, in what sense do time-dependent solutions exist?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 17. In what sense do solutions exist solving the time-dependent problem (2.16) subject to periodic boundary conditions and a top-hat detection function in a bounded domain?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a bounded domain equipped with periodic boundary conditions, and let $n \geq 1$ be a fixed integer. Consider $n$ interacting populations whose densities $u_i(x,t) \geq 0$, $i = 1,\dots,n$, and associated cognitive maps $k_i(x,t)$, $i = 1,\dots,n$, are coupled by a system of the form
$$\partial_t u_i = \nabla \cdot \big( D_i \nabla u_i - \chi_i u_i \nabla(\overline{k_i})_R \big) + f_i(u_1,\dots,u_n), \qquad x \in \Omega,\ t > 0,$$
$$\partial_t k_i = u_i \, \langle g, R\rangle \sum_{j=1}^n \rho_{ij}\, u_j - (\mu + \beta u_i)\, k_i, \qquad x \in \Omega,\ t > 0,$$
where $D_i, \chi_i, \mu, \beta > 0$, $\rho_{ij} \in \mathbb{R}$ encodes pairwise interaction (conflict) strengths between populations $i$ and $j$, and the nonlocal perception operator is given by spatial convolution
$$(\overline{k_i})_R(x,t) = \int_\Omega \Theta_R(x-y)\, k_i(y,t)\, dy$$
with the discontinuous "top-hat" detection function
$$\Theta_R(z) = \frac{1}{|B_R|}\, \mathbf{1}_{\{|z| \leq R\}}, \qquad R > 0.$$
The term $u_i \langle g, R\rangle \sum_j \rho_{ij} u_j$ represents conflicts perceived nonlocally at radius $R$ before being committed to memory, while $(\mu + \beta u_i) k_i$ models memory decay.

Determine in what sense (e.g., classical, strong, weak, mild, distributional, Hölder-continuous weak) time-dependent solutions to this coupled PDE-ODE system exist on $\Omega \times (0,T)$ for prescribed nonnegative initial data $u_i(\cdot,0), k_i(\cdot,0)$, given that the convolution kernel $\Theta_R$ is discontinuous. Establish a corresponding existence (and, where possible, uniqueness) theory.
artifact.status_search_result: For closely related single-species nonlocal advection–diffusion models with spatial memory and top-hat detection, recent work has established existence and uniqueness of Hölder-continuous weak solutions in one spatial dimension allowing the discontinuous top-hat kernel, addressing a regularity gap left by earlier contraction-mapping arguments. The full multi-species conflict-generation system with periodic boundary conditions in a bounded domain appears to be only partially addressed; a complete existence theory in arbitrary dimension does not appear in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Biological aggregations from spatial memory and nonlocal advection
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and uniqueness of a Hölder continuous weak solution in one spatial dimension under general conditions, allowing for discontinuous kernels such as the top-hat detection kernel.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of Hölder weak solutions has been established in 1D for related models with the top-hat kernel, partially addressing the question for single-species cases.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of a Coupled Nonlocal PDE-ODE System with Spatial Memory
status_evidence.snippet: Well-posedness, stability, and bifurcation analysis for a coupled nonlocal PDE-ODE system with spatial memory.
status_evidence.claim: Well-posedness results have been obtained for related coupled PDE-ODE systems with spatial memory, indicating partial progress.
